episodes.synopsis: A blacksmith is forging an enormous sword while a dark man with only one eye and one arm stands back and watches.
episodes.title: The Black Swordsman

episodes.synopsis: There is a great battle taking place at a fort. The attackers are doing well, except one thing stands in their way -  a grey knight and he states that none shall pass him.
episodes.title: Band of the Hawk

episodes.synopsis: Guts and Griffith begin their sword fight.
episodes.title: First Battle

episodes.synopsis: Guts reminisces about his childhood.
episodes.title: The Hand of God

episodes.synopsis: Guts is now a commander of Griffith's army, taking many risks in battle, Casca takes him to task for it. Griffith is knighted in the Midland court much to the nobles' dismay.
episodes.title: A Wind of Swords

episodes.synopsis: In another raid, Guts and Griffith come across a demon known as Nosferatu Zodd.
episodes.title: Zodd the Immortal

episodes.synopsis: Princess Charlotte of Midland strikes up a friendship with Griffith.
episodes.title: The Sword`s Owner

episodes.synopsis: Griffith and Guts continue their success in battle and Griffith is made a Count.
episodes.title: Conspiracy

episodes.synopsis: Griffith saves Charlotte when her horse bolts during a fox hunt. Yurius, the king's younger brother, attempts to have him assassinated.
episodes.title: Assassination

episodes.synopsis: Guts, sent by Griffith, assassinates Yurius and his son Adonis. Griffith gets closer to Charlotte. The Hawks depart for yet another mission.
episodes.title: Nobleman

episodes.synopsis: On a stormy battlefield, Casca, Griffith's second in command, is wounded while fighting the leader of an enemy army. Guts runs to her rescue but when she passes out at the edge of a cliff, he cannot catch her in time and they both fall into the river below.
episodes.title: The Battle

episodes.synopsis: Casca is still unconscious, so Guts shelters them in a cave while the rain pours down. She comes to and tells Guts about her past and about Griffith's.
episodes.title: Together

episodes.synopsis: Guts and Casca try to fight their way back to the Hawks while the enemy army they were fighting from before try to stop them.
episodes.title: Prepared for Death

episodes.synopsis: Casca finds Judeau's division of Hawks and leads them back to where Guts was fighting alone. Although injured, he defeated all the enemy soldiers by himself. They return to the Hawks' camp and Casca tends to Guts' wounds.
episodes.title: Bonfire of Dreams

episodes.synopsis: The King of Midland and his various generals confer about Doldrey Castle, long since captured by the Chudan Empire. Griffith plans an attack and the King agrees despite the protests of his other officers. Only one other general supports Griffith's actions. The Hawks attack Doldrey.
episodes.title: The Decisive Battle

episodes.synopsis: With the help of Nosferatu Zodd, Guts defeats the defender of Doldrey Castle.
episodes.title: The Conqueror

episodes.synopsis: With the victory at Doldrey, Griffith is promoted to White Phoenix General, an aristocratic title. The Queen of Midland and other court conspirators try to poison Griffith.
episodes.title: Moment of Glory

episodes.synopsis: Griffith has his revenge by having the Queen's castle burned down.
episodes.title: Tombstone of Flames

episodes.synopsis: Griffith will not let Guts simply leave. He says that Guts belongs to him.
episodes.title: Separation

episodes.synopsis: Guts arrives at the home of Godo the swordsmith and stays there for a while while Godo crafts a new sword for him. Guts practices more on his sword techniques with the help of Godo's little daughter Erika.
episodes.title: Sparks

episodes.synopsis: Guts returns in time to save the remaining Hawks from annihilation.
episodes.title: Confession

episodes.synopsis: With Guts help, Casca and the Hawks hope to rescue Griffith.
episodes.title: Infiltration

episodes.synopsis: Breaking away from the King's pursuing armies, the few Hawks left contemplate their future. Guts comforts Casca, who is despondent over Griffith's condition. Griffith begins to dream.
episodes.title: Eve of the Feast

episodes.synopsis: Seduced by the promises of demons and his dreams from his childhood, Griffith agrees to fulfill his destiny and become one of the God Hand demons.
episodes.title: The Great Eclipse

episodes.synopsis: Griffith's men are sacrificed to the demon's appetites. Guts fights on, at first to save Griffith, then to save himself from the result of Griffith's ambition.
episodes.title: Time of Eternity
